recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of a woman with voluminous, dark, textured hair, wearing a pink sequined halter dress. The image features a soft-focus, hazy quality characteristic of late 70s photography, with a neutral grey-blue gradient background and warm, diffused lighting on the skin.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, expansive hair framing the face against the light background
The diagonal line created by the bare shoulder and the hands clasped at the chest
The contrast between the matte skin texture and the reflective sequins of the garment
The balance between the large display text in the upper left and the smaller subtitle in the upper right
coreInvariants: Soft-focus diffusion across the entire frame
Pink sequined fabric with visible circular highlights

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered subject with head slightly tilted; hair occupies approximately 40% of the upper frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the upper third line, providing a direct gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the clasped hands and sequins, then arcs up to the typography in the corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space in the upper corners, utilized for typographic placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm skin tones and dusty rose pink (subject)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high value; high saturation in the pink garment; overall soft, low-contrast tonal range.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance
Limit to muted 1970s pastels and earth tones

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, connected cursive with high stroke contrast
Ascenders and descenders that taper into fine points
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated, looping flourishes
Lower case 'g' and 'y' have long, sweeping descender loops
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and angle contrast; the primary name is large and horizontal, while the title is small and angled.
graphicDevices: Thin white drop-glow/outline on dark text to separate from dark hair

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, formal script aesthetic of the era
Offers similar flourishes and calligraphic weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with voluminous 70s-style dark hair, wearing a pink sequined halter dress, against a neutral grey-blue gradient background. Ensure a hazy, diffused lighting effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom calligraphic script lettering in the top left (large, stacked) and top right (small, angled 15 degrees). Use solid black with a very thin white outer glow for the top left text.

verificationChecks: Is the hair texture frizzy and voluminous?
Does the lighting feel diffused and soft-focus?
Is the pink dress clearly sequined?
Is the typography a high-contrast formal script?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not look 'stamped' on but integrated into the soft atmosphere.
Check that the sequins have realistic light catchers.
Verify the skin tones are warm and glowing rather than flat.
Confirm the script flourishes are smooth and not jagged.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a soft-focus 70s studio portrait with high-contrast calligraphic script placed in the upper quadrants to create a vintage album aesthetic.
